items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had Horsecollar on the piano

ctx.x: That's why I say I can't remember -- I don't remember reading no music on a Teddy Wilson date. We walk on a date and put it together. A lot of them dates.

Especially Frankie Newton (inaudible). I had heard (inaudible) arrangements on things, man, (inaudible). I remember one time when I was travelling with my band, "Mr. Bear," in '56. We went in -- I had Horsecollar on the piano, two great guitar players and rhythm section.
